xmldoc.short_description: Minimum norm least-squares solution of a linear system.

param_input_item.param_description: a single or double matrix (sparse input is converted to full).
a single or double matrix with as many rows as A.
'nowarn' (default) or 'warn' to report a rank deficiency.

param_output_item.param_description: the solution with the smallest norm among the least-squares solutions.

description.p: X = lsqminnorm(A, B) returns the least-squares solution of A * X = B that has the smallest norm, also when A is rank deficient or has more columns than rows.

The rank is set by a QR factorization with column pivoting: diagonal values of the triangular factor not above tol are dropped. A complete orthogonal decomposition then gives the minimum norm solution.
With 'warn', a warning reports the rank when it is lower than min(size(A)).
